name: Boku no Kanojo wa Joou-sama
source:
Takashi has somehow hooked up with the school's most popular girl, Ayana.
He gets her drunk and manages to get her home, where she reveals her bedroom nature... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE131503.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
隆志不知怎么和学校最受欢迎的女孩绫奈交往上了。
他把她灌醉，设法把她送回家，而她在那里展现出了卧室里的本性……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE131503.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
